verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਕਟਾਛ ਦਿੱਬ ਦੇਹ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharasan dhiaan dhib dhirasaT pragaas bhiee karunaa kaTaachh dhi'b dheh paravaan hai ||

en.bdb: Focusing mind on the form of True Guru, one is enlightened with celestial vision of knowledge. By the grace of True Guru, the human form acquires Godly refulgence making its coming to this world a success.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬੱਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv ba'jar kapaaT khule prem ras rasan kai a(n)mirat nidhaan hai ||

en.bdb: Concentrating the mind on the divine word, the rock strong doors of ignorance become ajar. The acquisition of knowledge then blesses one with the treasure of Lord's name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ  ਹਸਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਗਯਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh baasanaa subaas  hasat poojaa pranaam safal su gayaan hai ||

en.bdb: The touching and feeling of the dust of True Guru's feet enlivens the fragrance of Lord's name in the mind. Involving the hands in His prayer and service, one is blessed with true and real spiritual knowledge.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਬਿਸਮ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਇ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)g a(n)g bisam sraba(n)g mai samai bhe man manasaa thakat braham dhiaan hai ||34||

en.bdb: Thus every hair of a person becomes glorious and he merges with the light divine. All his vices and desires end and his mind dwells in the love of Lord's feet. (18)
